title: a16z Podcast: The Biology of Pain

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: What is the nature of physical pain?
reader_summary.overview: What is the nature of physical pain? Do people experience pain differently? What is happening in our brains and our bodies when we experience pain? What is the biological link between pain and addiction? In this episode Clifford Woolf, Professor of Neurobiology at Harvard Medical School and a renowned expert on understanding pain.

key_points.text: In this episode Clifford Woolf, Professor of Neurobiology at Harvard Medical School and a renowned expert on understanding pain.
Technology is enabling a new, deeper, and much more complex understanding of pain—which pathways and neurons are activated in the brain when.
We now understand that the notion of pain as a simple switch that can be switched on or off (you have pain/you don't have pain) and measured by categories like mild.
